name: pickleshell
description: Secure MCP bridge from ChatGPT to a locally operated OpenCode agent

scripts.build: npm --prefix mcp-server run build && npm --prefix terminal run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix gateway test && npm --prefix mcp-server test && npm --prefix terminal test && npm --prefix pickleshell-memory-mcp test && bash test/deployment-release.test.sh
scripts.audit: npm --prefix gateway audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix mcp-server audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix terminal audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix pickleshell-memory-mcp audit --omit=dev
